summary: Structure and coarse physical limits (D-UM21-Q01-1 = B applied to GT23 as the least-change default; logged here) on all 19,573 E01 observations (8,831 cycles, 10,254 transfers, 488 continuous recordings). 18,758 have no failure found, 815 failed. Failures: L5 pressure point 590 observations, L2 jump 189, L1 angle range 40, S5 side check 10 (observations can fail more than one). Stairs pressure point confirmed, kept. Step-up pressure point fails in almost every observation. No scientific approval. Independent verifier not yet run.
decisions_applied: D-UM21-Q01-1 = B (structure plus coarse physical limits, blatant errors only; no literature-fitted ranges; no tuning to a pass rate), applied to GT23 as the least-change default
agent_defaults_logged: L1, L2, L3, L4 ported unchanged from run_um21_q01_assessment.py (a test asserts the bounds are equal); angles are radians and converted to degrees; unit comes from the column suffix and an unknown suffix refuses to run.

L5 (new): foot-frame pressure point beyond 0.5 m anterior or 0.3 m vertical/lateral of the foot origin; written before any GT23 data were read, chosen so the old stairs error (0.4 to 0.9 m below the foot) would show.

S5 (new): side check on cycles, ipsilateral mean vertical force in the first 40 percent of the cycle must exceed that in the last 40 percent; applies only with all 150 samples finite and a peak of at least 20 N.
Stairs rule written before the data: hold only if more than 1 percent of finite stairs pressure-point samples fail L5, or the C06 outside-foot share of stairs is above that of normal walking.
Flight check for the run-label question: share and longest run of phase samples where both legs are under 20 N.
Pilot = AB07 and AB12 (right-foot offset; stairs), chosen before the run. Participants are assessed one per job.
Observations with failures are marked failed in observations.jsonl; the export is not changed, nothing is removed. Filtering belongs to R01 / the E01 relabel step.

Both fixed (pilot_v2 still not clean for the output-name reason; pilot_v3 clean). v1 and v2 roots are superseded, kept as evidence.

failures.step_up_pressure_point: L5: 140,544 of 973,332 finite step_up pressure-point samples fail (vertical coordinate about -0.5 m, same pattern as the old stairs error: a raised surface under the foot). 500 of 506 step-up observations with a pressure point fail (step_up_left 176, step_up_right 190, step_up_unlabelled 134). C06 did not hold them (outside-foot share 12.5 percent). Recommend holding the foot-frame pressure point for step_up in the E01 relabel/hold step; not done here (export unchanged).
failures.angle_wraps: L2 jumps of about 360 degrees and L1 values near -180 degrees are branch wraps in the right foot and ankle angle (examples AB13 dynamic_walk_1 sample 19259, AB10 meander_1, AB07 twister_1); cutting and curb recordings carry many L2 jumps (89 degrees in AB12 cutting_1). 59 recordings carry L1 or L2 failures. Cause not investigated here.

stairs_cop.reading: 0 of 242,751 finite stairs pressure-point samples fail L5; the C06 outside-foot share of stairs has median 0.7 percent (normal walk 11.9 percent); ankle moment ratio median 1.085 (normal walk 1.119). The C06 rework fixed the stairs plate-frame error.

shuffle_115.resolution: recorded as limitation 'shuffle_not_steady_walking' on each observation; keep out of any walking profile. Export unchanged (family move is an E01 relabel/R01 question). Authors' README: shuffle = walking at 0.4 m/s.

functional_task_2463.resolution: recorded as limitation; 1,716 normal_walk + 747 incline_walk cycles with no authors window; not invented as a label. 511 of the 1,716 normal_walk cycles show flight (both legs unloaded 21 percent median of the cycle) so they cannot be walking; for the other 1,205 neither plate pair is available (right plate NaN), so unknown. Keep out of walking profiles.

run_label_795.resolution: Authors' README calls normal_walk 2-0 and 2-5 'walking at 2.0 / 2.5 m/s'. In the data every run-labelled cycle that has both plate forces shows a flight phase (2.0 m/s: 347 of 347, median 17 percent of the cycle with both legs under 20 N; 2.5 m/s: 359 of 359, median 25 percent). Both plates are available for 706 of the 795; 89 cannot be checked. Flight cannot occur in walking, so the 'run' label is supported by the data and NO relabel to walking is needed; the README wording disagrees with the data. No walking control exists (the right plate is NaN in the 1.2 and 1.8 m/s walking cycles), so the statistic is not calibrated against walking. E01-verify's remark that the authors label these run is not right: the README says walking.

mass_estimated_45.resolution: limitation carried on each observation; factors estimated from force plates (up to about 5 percent for AB09).

ab09_divisor.resolution: limitation: nearest listed mass 87.6 kg used, may be off by about 5 percent; dynamic_walk_1 and weighted_walk_1.

ab07_right_foot.resolution: limitation carried on all AB07 observations; L5 finds only 42 AB07 observations failing (step-ups 25, agility 1, others); the roughly 30 percent outside-the-marker-foot share from C06 is below the blatant L5 limit and is not a failure here; cause unresolved.

curb_up_cop_held.resolution: foot-frame pressure point held (E01 held_signals, state not_checked_no_column); lab-axis force and plate pressure point kept.

nm_rerun_limit.resolution: limitation: the 7 'exact' rescale recordings were confirmed against a local inverse-dynamics re-run to about 0.04 percent of the peak, not to 1e-3 N*m; moments are not checked here.

window_span_both_legs.resolution: limitation: each of 5,127 spans exported for left and right; all pairs complete (0 unpaired); keeping one leg per span is an R01 scope question.

ab05_left_right_cycles.observed: AB05 436 left, 70 right cycles; every participant has more left than right (left 436 to 706, right 70 to 177, summary table).
ab05_left_right_cycles.cause: Publisher README line 93: treadmill trials are missing one force plate (the right leg on treadmill trials except declines) due to broken equipment, and cycles come from 20 N heel strikes on the plates. AB05 treadmill recordings have plate_missing right = true (normal_walk 136 cycles, dynamic_walk 88, walk_backward 75 all left only) and the decline walking cycles (36) are right-leg only. Right-leg cycles survive only from overground and both-plate recordings. AB05 has no valid running trials (README) and fewer right-plate recordings than the others.
ab05_left_right_cycles.not_an_error: a plate-coverage consequence, not a side swap: S5 passes for all 8,821 other cycles including AB05

limitations_source_vs_conversion: Source limits (treadmill right plate, AB07 zero A/P force and right-foot offset, AB09 divisor, estimated masses, README units note) are recorded separately from conversion fidelity (E01 readback). Preserving them does not approve them.
profile_statements: No phase or time profile is produced. The coarse limits apply to every task, protocol and observation type; no range was fitted, widened or tuned; failures are reported, not filtered.
not_checked: moments, powers, forces, velocities, lab-axis pressure point, heading and frontal/transverse columns (no limit)
literature textbook ranges (never confirmed against a primary text; carried from UM21)
cause of the foot-angle branch wraps and of the cutting and curb jumps
whether side-shuffle S5 failures are real
scientific approval of any family label
